data: Microsoft's operating income rose by about 45.2% from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2025. In fiscal 2023, which ended June 30, 2023, operating income was roughly $88.5 billion ($88,523 million). In fiscal 2025, which ended June 30, 2025, it reached about $128.5 billion ($128,528 million). That is an increase of roughly $40.0 billion over the two years. Along the way, fiscal 2024 operating income was about $109.4 billion, so growth was about 24% in fiscal 2024 and about 17% in fiscal 2025. Most of the gain came from the Microsoft Cloud and the Intelligent Cloud segment, led by Azure. These figures are from Microsoft's annual 10-K reports and are worth checking against the filings if you need exact precision.
